title: Public source preview and portable Windows build
summary: First source-linked ClipCraft preview. Includes the latest editor and lean beta work, with portable ZIP packaging and an auditable build/dependency inventory.

Distribution: Complete buildable Rust source under Apache-2.0, with original assets, synthetic fixtures and third-party notices.
Portable Windows x64 application and CLI; checksums, SPDX dependency inventory and exact source commit.
GitHub workflows for checks, dependency advisories and draft prereleases. GitHub-built packages include artifact attestations.
Included functionality: Capture controller, region/window/fullscreen/Steps workflows and configurable hotkeys.
Editable tools, groups, guides, raster effects, Library and image-frame cropping.
PNG/JPEG/raster-PDF export and Windows print dialog; installed fonts, imported stamps and Library bulk actions.

limitations: Unsigned preview software; signed Windows installers are a separate planned milestone.
Native regression checks for raster-effect interactions, Library/cropping/window restoration, printing/export dialogs, and the new fonts/stamps/Library controls remain pending.
Automated tests and headless checks are evidence for their tested scope, not full native parity or a security certification.
Video/All-in-One capture, mixed formatting in one text box, centralized enterprise deployment policies and an in-app updater are not included.
Editable projects retain original pixels; share flattened output when redacting. PDF is raster, and installed fonts are not embedded.
Some roadmap evidence points to private historical local checks, which are not included in the public source.
